listings.title: Kindred Paws Dog Grooming
listings.description: Kindred Paws Dog Grooming is Emily's home-based, one-on-one dog grooming service in the Morgan's Point area of Port Colborne, Ontario. In her September 2026 submission, she described welcoming dogs of all breeds and sizes from the Niagara region. Her Facebook introduction says she works with one dog at a time and welcomes both single- and double-coated dogs; the page also says dogs with different temperaments are welcome. Public posts show bath-and-groom visits, tidy-ups, and coat brush-outs, though these examples are not a complete service menu. The page invites owners to book by Facebook message or text. Ask what a visit includes for your dog's coat and handling needs, the current price and availability, and the exact home appointment location. The business supplied three photos with permission to display them here.
listings.convenienceText: One dog at a time in a home-based setting near Morgan's Point; book by Facebook message or text and ask for the exact address before visiting.

listings.title: GroomArts Academy
listings.category: Dog grooming school and student grooming service
listings.address: 6465 Cartmell Place SW, Edmonton, AB T6W 4V4, Canada
listings.description: GroomArts Academy is a dog grooming school in southwest Edmonton that provides hands-on, salon-style training with instructors supervising students as they work with pets. Customers who choose a student groom receive 50% off the academy's regular grooming rates, giving pet owners a lower-cost option while students build practical experience. The published curriculum covers bathing, brushing, blow-drying, de-shedding, nail trimming, ear cleaning, sanitary care, clipping, scissoring, styling, safe handling, coat health, and breed-specific coat types. Contact GroomArts Academy to confirm current appointment availability, eligible services, the regular price before the discount, and how the groom will be supervised.

listings.title: K9 Designs by Tanice
listings.description: K9 Designs by Tanice offers private, one-to-one dog grooming in Willis Point, British Columbia. Tanice describes the setting as a quiet forest retreat, with no kennels and an unhurried approach to each visit. Her owner-supplied grooming portfolio includes full grooms, bathing and fluff-drying, haircut and styling examples, and a puppy introduction that allowed time for treats and play while getting familiar with grooming sounds and sensations. The accompanying photo stories emphasize taking breaks when a dog needs time to settle. Email Tanice directly to discuss your dog's coat, the grooming you need, appointment availability, current rates, and directions before visiting.
listings.convenienceText: Private, quiet forest setting in Willis Point; no kennels; unhurried one-to-one grooming.

listings.title: The Blissful Dog
listings.address: 6385 Main Street, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON L4A 1G4, Canada
listings.description: The Blissful Dog is a women-owned dog grooming salon at 6385 Main Street in Whitchurch-Stouffville, Ontario, run by co-owners and groomers Annelise and Caitlin. Its October 2026 submission confirms full grooms, bath-and-brush appointments and nail trims. The official website also lists bath-and-tidy visits, breed clips, puppy grooming, deshedding and a self-serve dog wash. Owners can book online through Groomore or call the salon to discuss their dog's coat, preferred finish and handling needs. The website describes appointments that begin with a coat check and a discussion of the requested haircut; it asks clients to mention nervousness, senior-dog needs or a first groom when booking. Published hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday, 9 AM to 3 PM; Sunday is closed. Confirm the package inclusions, appointment length and current quote directly. The seven salon and grooming photos were supplied by the business with permission to display them.
